description: Retrieve a published entity profile by type and exact slug, with structured data and claim previews. Beverage evidence contains selected scanned statements and public sources in alcohol, ingredients_technique and sensory, excluding offer-tagged claims; has_more false does not establish full inventory coverage. Alcohol declarations retain their exact wording; missing alcohol information is unknown, not zero. Profiled businesses are independent of Beyond Wine. Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining, including wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. The connection cannot place orders or take payments and cannot guarantee every drink contains absolutely no alcohol.
name: get_entity
title: Get entity
